title: coleus gratus
intro: Coleus gratus, commonly known as the Malay coleus or Selab, is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family, known for its vibrant foliage and medicinal properties. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Coleus gratus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing pain and improving cardiovascular health. The plant's therapeutic actions may include its ability to exhibit analgesic, anti-diabetic, and antimicrobial effects, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
